records.name: Guatemala Health Initiative

notes: All 20 clubs were read through the public clubs API entry (WebFetch, no WebSearch used). The directory status was re-checked for every club because the first pass did not capture it for all of them. Twelve clubs carry an INACTIVE status name (the active flag is true for most of them, a conflict), so they are held back as unknown with no summary, categories or interests, per the brief. The other 8 are written in full: Guatemala Health Initiative is active from its own site (2026 dates); Grupo Quisqueyano, Hack4Impact, Hawaii Club, Hearts for the Homeless Penn (status PRELIMINARY), Hillel Soup Kitchen, Hype Dance Crew and iFGLI are probably_active from the directory flag with no dated item. All 20 directory entries have empty event lists, so no active status rests on a directory event. The application_required values (1, 3, 4) are not explained in the entries and were not used as evidence. Club websites read once each: Guatemala Health Initiative, Hype Dance Crew (home page only), Hyperloop, Impact Investing, and Hack4Impact (403). The IPDGA website was not fetched because its listing is held back. Personal names and personal emails in the entries were not recorded. Searches used 0 of 0. Fetches used 41 of 60. No rate limiting was seen. Records written 20, verdicts publish 20 (8 full, 12 held back as unknown).
